article.headline: Weddings.io Technologies Rebrands After AI Search Reveals a New Challenge for Digital Companies: Brand Identity in the Machine Era
article.description: After more than two decades building digital brands, the team behind weddings.io says AI search introduced a new problem: companies are no longer only competing for human attention — they are being interpreted by machines. The result is Weddings.io Technologies and a dedicated industry publication, WeddingSaaS.com.
